title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 5
notes: Fresh-main deterministic top-five one-event depth batch after merge 3729d992a89087221fe681fd349065f837fec403. Selection comes from current canonical queue: Nunchuk, Keplr, Petra, GridPlus, UniSat Wallet. Historical queue IDs are not identity authority. No launch dates are inferred.

events.title: Nunchuk unveiled a redesigned Group Wallet
events.description: Nunchuk announced a redesigned Group Wallet that removed the prior Matrix dependency, derived a shared encryption key from wallet output descriptors, simplified cross-device recovery, and made the collaborative multisig wallet available to all Nunchuk users.

events.title: Keplr documented multilingual, smart-grouping, and Side Panel features
events.description: Keplr's official support documentation, updated on 2025-09-23, documented multilingual and multi-fiat settings, Smart Grouping for assets spread across chains, and Chrome Side Panel mode for Keplr Wallet.

events.title: Petra 2.0.0 delivered a redesigned wallet experience
events.description: Aptos Labs' Petra App Store version history records Petra 2.0.0 on 2025-07-29 with a refreshed design across mobile, extension, and web, smoother send/swap/staking flows, performance and navigation improvements, and improved support for multi-tabs, Earn, and liquid staking.

events.title: GridPlus highlighted Lattice1 hardware clear-signing defenses after the Bybit hack
events.description: GridPlus published a first-party post explaining how the Lattice1's hardware ABI parsing and clear-signing design exposes smart-contract transaction details on the secure device for user verification, using the February 2025 Bybit incident as the motivating example.

events.title: UniSat Wallet extension v1.6.0 removed Atomicals support and fixed Keystone signing
events.description: UniSat Wallet extension v1.6.0 was published on 2025-04-03, removing Atomicals token support, fixing Keystone hardware-wallet signing bugs and potential vulnerabilities, and improving wallet loading speed.

evidence.title: Group Wallet: Simpler, Stronger, Better
evidence.notes: First-party Nunchuk article announcing the redesigned Group Wallet architecture and availability.

evidence.title: Additional Features
evidence.notes: Official Keplr support page documenting multilingual, multi-fiat, Smart Grouping, and Chrome Side Panel capabilities; update date used conservatively as discovery chronology.

evidence.title: Petra: Aptos Crypto Wallet — Version History
evidence.notes: Developer-maintained App Store version history records Petra 2.0.0 and its redesign across mobile, extension, and web.

evidence.title: GridPlus Hardware Wallets Could Have Helped Prevent the $1.5B Bybit Crypto Hack. Here's How.
evidence.notes: First-party GridPlus article documents Lattice1 clear-signing and hardware ABI parsing as transaction-verification features.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet Extension v1.6.0
evidence.notes: Official UniSat Wallet extension release documents Atomicals removal, Keystone signing fixes, vulnerability fixes, and wallet loading improvements.
